In a file that imports from `vitest`, the first parameter of a test is the test context, as in Vitest. Before Bun 1.5 it was `done`. The test now ends when its function returns, so an `expect` that fails in a later timer can be missed.

`--fix` returns a promise that `done` settles. If `done()` is only the last statement, it removes it. It leaves an `async` function alone, and one that returns a value.

`bun lint --upgrade` runs this rule. See [Upgrade Bun](/lint#upgrade-bun).

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"bun/no-vitest-done-callback" = "error" # or "warn"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```ts
import { expect, test } from "vitest";

test("emits ready", done => {
  server.on("ready", port => {
    expect(port).toBe(3000);
    done();
  });
});
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```ts
import { expect, test } from "vitest";

test("emits ready", () =>
  new Promise<void>(done => {
    server.on("ready", port => {
      expect(port).toBe(3000);
      done();
    });
  }));

test("needs a GPU", context => {
  if (!hasGpu()) context.skip();
});
```

`bun:test` still has `done`:

{/* good */}
```ts
import { test } from "bun:test";

test("emits ready", done => {
  server.on("ready", () => done());
});
```
